intro.summary: Northwest community between the Bow River and Kensington Road west of 14 Street NW, where post-war bungalows are rebuilt as single and semi-detached infills.
intro.body: West Hillhurst runs west from Hillhurst toward Crowchild Trail, between the Bow River and the escarpment, with shops along 19 Street NW. Its post-war bungalows on 50-foot lots are a steady source of infill. New single-detached homes and pairs of semi-detached homes are common.
